description: Team-defined engineering gestures and arbitrary demo word mappings. These are not verified ISL or ASL signs. REST is a relaxed hand, distinct from open palm.

REST.pose: Relaxed fingers with moderate natural bend; do not form a target pose

THUMB_UP.pose: Thumb extended and other four fingers bent

INDEX_UP.pose: Index extended and other fingers bent

V_SHAPE.pose: Index and middle extended; remaining fingers bent

THREE_FINGERS.pose: Index, middle and ring extended; thumb and little bent

LITTLE_UP.pose: Little finger extended; other fingers bent

THUMB_LITTLE.pose: Thumb and little extended; other fingers bent
